name: SiemensS7Connector
description: Polls Siemens S7 PLCs (S7-300/400/1200/1500) over ISO-on-TCP (data blocks, memory, inputs, outputs) and publishes each asset dataset as a JSON object to the MQTT broker or the broker state store.

inboundEndpoints.description: A Siemens S7 PLC (S7-300, S7-400, S7-1200, S7-1500) reachable over ISO-on-TCP on port 102.

address.description: S7 PLC address: s7://host:port (or host:port; the port defaults to 102).

additionalConfigurationSchema.title: S7 endpoint configuration
additionalConfigurationSchema.description: Connection settings of the PLC; defaults for every asset that uses this endpoint.

cpuType.title: CPU type
cpuType.description: CPU family. Selects how the connection (TSAP) is addressed.

rack.title: Rack
rack.description: Rack number of the CPU. 0 for S7-1200/1500 and most S7-300.

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: Slot number of the CPU. 1 for S7-1200/1500 (0 also works), 2 for S7-300. Default: 2 for S7300, otherwise 1.

timeoutMs.title: Response timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for each S7 response.

connectTimeoutMs.title: Connect timeout (ms)
connectTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the connection to be established.

datasetConfigurationSchema.title: S7 dataset configuration
datasetConfigurationSchema.description: Used for the asset default dataset configuration and for each dataset. A dataset value overrides the asset default.

samplingIntervalMs.title: Sampling interval (ms)
samplingIntervalMs.description: How often the dataset is read and published.

maxBytesPerRead.title: Max bytes per request
maxBytesPerRead.description: Upper bound of one merged read request. Larger requests are split into PDU-sized chunks automatically.

maxGap.title: Max address gap
maxGap.description: Data points up to this many unused bytes apart are read in one request. Reading a gap inside an existing data block is harmless.

dataSource.description: S7 absolute address: DB<n>.DBX<byte>.<bit>, DB<n>.DBB/DBW/DBD<byte>, or M/I/Q with bit (M0.1) or width B/W/D (MW10). German E/A are accepted for I/Q.

dataPointConfigurationSchema.title: S7 data point configuration
dataPointConfigurationSchema.description: How to decode one value. The address width fixes the default type: X Boolean, B Byte, W UInt16, D UInt32.

dataType.title: Data type
dataType.description: Boolean/Bool, Byte, SByte/SInt, Int16/Int, UInt16/UInt/Word, Int32/DInt, UInt32/UDInt/DWord, Int64/LInt, UInt64/ULInt/LWord, Float32/Real, Float64/LReal, or String (S7 STRING).

length.title: String length
length.description: Only for String: the declared size n of the S7 STRING[n] (characters).

bit.title: Bit
bit.description: Only for a Boolean read from a B/W/D address: the bit to extract, 0 = least significant.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Published value = raw * scale + offset (numeric types only).
